name: Witch Switched
source:
Reese is a man who is uncomfortable with himself and his life. He finds escapism by reading yuri (F/F) stories on his laptop.

One day while riding the subway, Lucy the witch sidles up next to him. Seeing an opportunity for mischief, she transforms Reese into a woman so he can “enjoy” this yuri content he so desperately craves—but in real-life!

Unfortunately for Lucy, Reese is ecstatic at this. Even worse, she realizes that the newly-elated Reese makes a pretty cute woman.

And when Reese suddenly asks her to go shopping, Lucy can’t refuse – after all, what if Reese does something nefarious in her new body?

[From [url=https://sapphicore.itch.io/witch-switched]itch.io[/url]]
